body:
I hesitated for a moment, the faint flicker of heat on the ceiling catching my attention. My curiosity piqued, I reached out tentatively, feeling a gentle warmth through the fabric of the blanket wrapped around me. It was almost too real - as if someone had lit a small candle or perhaps one of those fairy lights.

My heart raced slightly at the thought, but also an exhilarating sense of adventure surged within me.
full:
I hesitated for a moment, the faint flicker of heat on the ceiling catching my attention. My curiosity piqued, I reached out tentatively, feeling a gentle warmth through the fabric of the blanket wrapped around me. It was almost too real - as if someone had lit a small candle or perhaps one of those fairy lights.

My heart raced slightly at the thought, but also an exhilarating sense of adventure surged within me. Next: move closer and examine it carefully.
